description: Skelet AF-03a versioned agent contract freeze

compatibility.instructions: Does the new agent-contract schema, validator, fixtures, or CI bootstrap line break existing validators, hygiene, or workflow schema?

correctness.instructions: Are the envelope fields, 13 error codes, URI patterns, evidence modes, tool-name list, or valid/invalid fixture verdicts factually wrong against the implemented validator and the existing MCP/REST surface?

evidence.instructions: Are the 7 contract tests, gate pass proof, hygiene, and Graft isolation sufficient for an additive schema freeze with no behavior change?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism, unhandled fixture shape, or traversal URI that validates as in-contract?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond additive contract freeze: MCP/REST behavior change, migration, UI, billing, donor import, or unrelated refactors?

security.instructions: Does the change weaken URI validation, admit invented error codes, or leak secrets in fixtures or messages?

state.change: AF-03a additive contract freeze: schemas/agent-contract.schema.json with skelet.agent.v1 envelope, 13 typed error codes, stable URI patterns, evidence modes; scripts/validate_agent_contract.py gate; 4 fixtures with valid and invalid verdicts; 7-test suite; 1-line CI bootstrap wiring. No MCP, REST, Lens, search, or DB behavior change. Follow-up evidence-only commit adds Jev spec/review, OCR delegation, and PStack panels with no product change.
